core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nashir is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Publisher, spreader, announcer”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nashir corresponds to the Arabic form نَاشِر (Arabic root ن ش ر (n-sh-r); نَاشِر (Nāshir)). Its core sense is publisher, spreader, announcer. persian.name: ناشر
